what: the title seam — v1_7_0's only observable difference from v1_6_1
note: `test: null` means the whole suite, and here it is load-bearing rather
than cautious: the title rule lives in avatar.dart but is *observed* in
six variant builders, two parity files and a fixture assertion. A narrowed
run would report survivors for mutations another file kills.
Group A is the version→flag decision in avatar.dart. A-3 is the one worth
reading: deleting the throw turns `title: false` at v1_6_1 into a silent
no-op, which is exactly the behaviour the ticket's acceptance forbids and
exactly what upstream does. It has to be a test that catches it, because
nothing about the output looks wrong.
Group B is the emission itself, in two variants — enough to prove the
parity fixtures see the flag on both sides. B-3 replaces the title's text
with the empty string: the element is still there, still first, still
well-formed, and only a byte comparison against upstream can tell.
